description: This file defines the EvaluationRunTracerLlama class, which manages callback registration and metrics calculation for evaluation runs involving language models, including token counting and event handling.

classes.name: EvaluationRunTracerLlama
classes.description: Class responsible for tracking evaluation run metrics, managing callback events, and extracting evaluation metadata.

methods.name: constructCallBacks
methods.description: Initializes callback handlers for various model and retrieval events, ensuring they are registered only once.

methods.name: calculateAndSetMetrics
methods.description: Calculates metrics based on event data, updates token counts, and records metrics for evaluation.

methods.name: injectEvaluationMetadata
methods.description: Injects evaluation run ID into node data and caller object for evaluation tracking.

methods.name: extractText
methods.description: Utility function to extract concatenated text from message content, handling different message formats.
